decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 17 and 18 and same-row DeepSeek fields.

test_case.test_name: Verified x8-device per-controller SDDC correction validation
test_case.purpose: Validate x8-device SDDC on every approved controller using a confirmed supported x8 DIMM population, exact slot attribution, continued operation and no fault-light assertion.
required_package: Approved x8-device DIMM PN/revision/rank and population recipe
Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and x8sddc oracle
Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI/indicator map and recovery checklist
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator powers down/discharges the SUT, installs and documents the approved x8-device population under ESD control, then verifies trained topology. A qualified FAE captures `mc.dimminfo()`, validates the signed tuple for each controller and invokes `ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel, rank=0, errType="x8sddc")` once per target. Capture x8-specific transcript, Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot attribution, normal health and both no-light states, then restore hardware/BIOS baseline.
test_case.expected_result: The approved x8 population trains correctly; every in-scope controller reports the package-defined x8 SDDC correction at the mapped physical slot; operation remains within the normal envelope; applicable records agree; front-panel and DIMM lightpath remain off; baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative x8 device-width/PN and seating proof, complete controller coverage, x8-specific correction evidence, correct slot/severity, normal health, no-light images and restoration. Unknown/x4 width, generic CE, wrong/missing target, training failure, lamp assertion, instability or incomplete restoration is not PASS.
safety_gate: Remove power/discharge and use approved ESD controls before DIMM handling.
Verify keying, supported population, orientation and seating; never force a module.
Preserve logs and validate trained topology/tuple before one injection.
Stop on training failure, wrong width/slot, UCE severity, crash, lamp assertion or persistent memory error; no auto-retry.
expected_evidence: x8 DIMM PN/device-width/rank/slot and ESD installation photos
Harness hash, trained topology and signed controller-to-tuple map
Per-target x8sddc transcript and Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot evidence
Restored population/BIOS, memory health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On hardware/training or injection anomaly, preserve evidence, stop and use only the qualified operator's powered-down ESD restoration. Verify original population, BIOS and memory health before any separately authorized rerun.
